mapper.sql: a.mail_att_idx, a.mail_idx, a.resend_att_id, a.file_name, a.stored_name, a.file_size, a.content_type, a.content_id, a.inline_yn, a.fetched_at, a.fetch_try_cnt, a.fetch_tried_at, a.fetch_err, a.attached_at, a.modified_at, a.modified_by, a.deleted_yn
mapper.select: SELECT FROM mail_att a WHERE a.mail_idx = #{mailIdx} AND a.deleted_yn = false ORDER BY a.mail_att_idx
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO mail_att ( mail_idx, resend_att_id, file_name, stored_name, file_size, content_type, content_id, inline_yn, fetched_at, attached_at, modified_at, modified_by, deleted_yn ) VALUES ( #{mailIdx}, #{resendAttId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{fileName}, #{storedName,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COALESCE(#{fileSize,jdbcType=BIGINT}, 0), #{contentType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{contentId,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, COALESCE(#{inlineYn,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 'N'), #{fetchedAt,jdbcType=TIMESTAMP_WITH_TIMEZONE}, now(), now(), #{modifiedBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, false ) ON CONFLICT (mail_idx, resend_att_id) DO NOTHING
mapper.select: SELECT FROM mail_att a WHERE a.fetched_at IS NULL AND a.deleted_yn = false AND a.resend_att_id IS NOT NULL AND a.fetch_try_cnt < #{maxTryCnt} AND (a.fetch_tried_at IS NULL OR a.fetch_tried_at < now() - (#{backoffMinutes} * INTERVAL '1 minute')) ORDER BY a.fetch_tried_at NULLS FIRST, a.mail_att_idx LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE mail_att SET fetch_try_cnt = fetch_try_cnt + 1, fetch_tried_at = now(), modified_at = now() WHERE mail_att_idx = #{mailAttIdx}

UPDATE mail_att SET stored_name = #{storedName}, file_size = COALESCE(#{fileSize,jdbcType=BIGINT}, file_size), content_type = COALESCE(#{contentType,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, content_type), fetched_at = now(), fetch_err = NULL, modified_at = now() WHERE mail_att_idx = #{mailAttIdx}
UPDATE mail_att SET fetch_err = #{fetchErr,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, fetch_tried_at = now(), modified_at = now() WHERE mail_att_idx = #{mailAttIdx}
UPDATE mail_att SET deleted_yn = true, modified_by = #{modifiedBy,jdbcType=VARCHAR}, modified_at = now() WHERE mail_att_idx = #{mailAttIdx} AND deleted_yn = false
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM mail_att a WHERE a.mail_idx = #{mailIdx} AND a.deleted_yn = false
